name: Paygine payment
author: paygine

sections.description:
The “Paygine” plugin is a payment solution for WooCommerce websites:
– Includes 9 built-in payment methods
– Suitable for legal entities and sole proprietors
– Fast cash deposits to your company account
– Full compliance with Federal Law No. 54-FZ
– Free setup

Plugin Setup

To accept payments through the plugin, submit a connection request to Paygine on the website https://paygine.ru. A company representative will contact you and grant you connection access.

Receipt Transfer Support
1. Set up fast receipt transfer to the tax office from Paygine in accordance with Federal Law No. 54-FZ.
2. Transfer receipts through partners (cloud cash registers “ATOL Online,” Orange Data, “Business.ru,” Kit Online, Cloud Kassir).

Pricing

Payment acceptance fees start at 1%. The commission is calculated individually for each business. To accurately assess the rate, please provide information on your company’s type of activity, average bill, and monthly turnover.

All Paygine Features

After connecting Paygine, 9 payment methods are available:
– Bank cards
– Fast Payment System
– Yandex Pay
– Mir Pay
– Sber Pay
– MTS Pay
– Play
– Share
– FINBOX

  • Personal account, where you can view all transactions, return payments, issue and send invoices, and contact Paygine support (Paygine support is available 24/7).
